plan.narration_reading: Opens on the weathered man with the wound that won't close (#01) under the hook. The wandering sheep + bowed figure (#08) on 'Isaiah wrote the healing would come through someone else'. The scourged back (#03) on 'wounded for our transgressions'. The apostle laying Isaiah's words on Christ (#07) on 'Peter took up Isaiah's words'; Christ bearing our sins (#09) on 'bare our sins in his own body'. The open welcoming hands (#13) on 'points the promise straight at you'. The dawn cross of completion (#12) on 'it was finished at the cross'; the same man now healed, scar closed (#14) on 'He has already closed'. Hero #06 — Christ in his own body on the tree — holds the close. Spread every ~4 beats so no slot drags.
plan.red_team_notes: 9 clips over ~70s still paces ~0.8-1.3x (a pilot, thinner than ideal) but spread evenly to avoid 12-16s holds. #13 has healed nail-marks (palms up) — resurrection-welcome, not a wound close-up, so no gem risk.
